scope: Source-level tests for EXT-F-1007-T10/T11/T12. No product code changed.
evidence_level: Focused Zustand store tests only; not native or browser evidence.

EXT-F-1007-T10.status: source-level pass for state mutation; UI/count behavior unverified
EXT-F-1007-T10.evidence: The real useScrapeStore removes each of three distinct image URLs in sequence, retains non-target entries after each removal, and marks the capture edited.

EXT-F-1007-T11.status: partial; Add image URL validation UI untested
EXT-F-1007-T11.evidence: The real store appends a distinct image with the model defaults and leaves an existing URL unduplicated. Blank-src rejection, draft retention, valid form submission, and Cancel clearing are inline in ScrapeView/AddItemRow and were not exercised through a component test.

EXT-F-1007-T12.status: partial; video row actions and blank-source form validation untested
EXT-F-1007-T12.evidence: The real store removes only the selected video while retaining the other URL, appends a distinct video with defaults, and leaves a duplicate unchanged. Opening and copying the rendered link, and the Add video URL blank/valid form behavior, were not exercised through a component test.

limitations: No native browser run, extension build, or full test suite was performed.
T11/T12 UI behavior is owned by inline handlers in ScrapeView; extracting or exposing those handlers for direct testing would require product code changes, outside this lane.
Store-level green does not establish rendered image counts, form validation, clipboard behavior, or native interactions.
